description: StayNest — indigo rental marketplace derived from reference R09. Fourth family and a fourth app category. Sans-led, light grey canvas, indigo reserved for actions, selection and verification.

typography.displayRoleNote: R09 is sans throughout; hierarchy is carried by weight and colour rather than a display face.

responsive.mobile: Single column. Property cards stack with a media block on top. Fixed bottom tab bar (Browse / Saved).
responsive.desktop: Two-column card grid. Tab bar hidden; navigation moves into the header.
